Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR CFTRI Project Associate – II (PAT-II) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the CSIR CFTRI Project Associate – II (PAT-II) position is 30th September 2026. It is advisable to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. degree in Food Science and Technology/Nutrition or an equivalent qualification from a recognized university. Additionally, 2 years of relevant research and development experience is mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Associate – II (PAT-II) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Project Associate – II (PAT-II) post is 35 years as of 30th September 2026. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any application charges.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate – II (PAT-II) role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 28,000/- plus House Rent Allowance (HRA). This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate – II (PAT-II) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Associate – II (PAT-II) position in the CSIR Central Food Technological Research Institute.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate – II (PAT-II) recruitment will involve shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview. Candidates are advised to prepare for both stages.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process for the CSIR CFTRI Project Associate – II (PAT-II) recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to visit the official website or use the provided link to submit their applications.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Project Associate – II (PAT-II) at CSIR CFTRI is a contractual job. This means the employment will be for a fixed tenure as per the project requirements.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the CSIR CFTRI located?
faq.answer: CSIR Central Food Technological Research Institute (CSIR CFTRI) is located in Mysuru, Karnataka. The recruitment is for candidates applying within this region.
